verdict.rationale: The pack documents no first-party feature for exporting all account data in open formats. The open-source and self-hosting docs and the management API's runs.list are only adjacent: a different deployment option and a developer building block, not an export capability. Missing for 10: a documented bulk data export, open export formats (e.g. JSON/CSV) covering runs, payloads, schedules and config, and a documented migration/offboarding path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Self-hosting Trigger.dev means you run and manage the platform on your own infrastructure
